known_pitfall_claim: The proof declares the hom bifunctor of C to have domain D^op × C, although its first argument must be an object of C^op.
pitfall_counterexample: Let C be the discrete category with one object ⋆ and only id⋆, and define D := C. Then Dᵒᵖ × C = Cᵒᵖ × C. The hom bifunctor sends (⋆,⋆) to Hom_C(⋆,⋆) = {id⋆}; its sole morphism maps to the identity function.
